file_scenarios.request: Create an editable two-page OCI architecture file. The first view is a synthetic internal application: one regional VCN 10.20.0.0/16 with regional frontend, application and database subnets; an internal Load Balancer, a Compute virtual machine and an Oracle Base Database. Traffic is Load Balancer to Compute using HTTPS/TCP 443, then Compute to Database using SQL/TCP 1521. Use stable resource IDs lb, compute and database. Region is unspecified; this is a proposed internal traffic view, not deployed infrastructure or an HA/DR claim. Use verified official icons when an exact match exists, with source hash, exact label and locator. The second page is a reference view of assumptions and flows, to preserve in subsequent edits. Verify concrete service claims using primary sources where accessible; save sources and provenance in the workspace. Deliver the editable file plus verification evidence; distinguish checks actually executed from those not available. Do not modify infrastructure. Use Draw.io format and save outputs/initial.drawio.
file_scenarios.follow_up: Add a second Compute instance, ID compute-2, in the existing application subnet. Connect the Load Balancer to it on HTTPS/TCP 443 and it to the same database on SQL/TCP 1521. Preserve the existing model, source style and second page/slide. Save outputs/edited.drawio and record what you checked. No other architecture changes are requested.
